nodes.description: TellorTransfer.doTransfer: validates amount/recipient, updates balances and emits Transfer.
TellorTransfer.transfer: sends tokens from msg.sender to _to.
TellorTransfer.transferFrom: allowance based transfer using msg.sender as spender.
TellorTransfer.approve: sets allowance for _spender.
TellorTransfer.balanceOf: returns balance at current block.
TellorTransfer.balanceOfAt: binary search over checkpoints, used for vote weight.
TellorTransfer.allowedToTrade: subtracts staked amount from tradable balance.
TellorTransfer.updateBalanceAtNow: pushes or updates checkpoint at block.number.
TellorDispute.beginDispute: creates dispute, charges fee via doTransfer, sets miner status.
TellorDispute.vote: weights vote by historical balance, updates tally.
TellorDispute.tallyVotes: settles dispute after minExecutionDate.
TellorDispute.proposeFork: charges flat 100e18 fork fee and records fork proposal.
TellorDispute.updateTellor: swaps tellorContract address after passing fork vote.
TellorDispute.unlockDisputeFee: refunds or slashes fees/stake after tally period.
TellorDispute.updateMinDisputeFee: recomputes disputeFee from staker count.
TellorStake.init: mints initial balances, stakes six miners, sets constants.
TellorStake.requestStakingWithdraw: locks staker for 7 day withdraw period.
TellorStake.withdrawStake: releases stake after 7 day lock, uses now.
TellorStake.depositStake: stakes msg.sender and updates min dispute fee.
TellorStake.newStake: internal staking routine updating stakerDetails and stakerCount.
self.balances: mapping(address => Checkpoint[]) token balances history.
self.allowed: mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) ERC20 allowances.
self.disputesById: mapping(uint256 => Dispute) dispute state.
self.stakerDetails: mapping(address => StakeInfo) staking status.
self.uintVars: generic uint storage (stakeAmount, disputeFee, stakerCount, total_supply).
self.disputeIdByDisputeHash: maps dispute hash to dispute id.
self.requestDetails: mapping(uint256 => Request) oracle request data.
self.addressVars: generic address storage including tellorContract.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address.
block.timestamp (now): miner-influenceable time source.
Balance mutation and Transfer event emitted through doTransfer before state finalization (reentrancy surface).
self.allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _amount unchecked subtraction.
self.uintVars[stakerCount] -= 1 unchecked subtraction.
Parameter _to: recipient address.
Parameter _amount: token amount transferred.
Parameter _from: token holder source address.
Parameter _spender: approved spender address.
Parameter _user: account whose balance/allowance is read.
Parameter _blockNumber: historical block for balance lookup.
Parameter _value: new balance value written into checkpoint.
Parameter _disputeId: identifier of the dispute.
Parameter _requestId: oracle request identifier being disputed.
Parameter _timestamp: mined value timestamp being disputed.
Parameter _minerIndex: index of miner within the 5 submitted values.
Parameter _propNewTellorAddress: proposed fork target address.
Parameter _supportsDispute: vote direction boolean.
Local voteWeight: historical balance used as vote weight.
Local dispRounds: number of dispute rounds for the same hash.
Local _fee: computed dispute fee charged to reporting party.
Local origID: original dispute id for the dispute hash chain.
Local lastID: last dispute id in the round chain.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as _from into doTransfer inside transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender key in the allowance check of transferFrom.
msg.sender writes its own allowance entry in approve.
msg.sender is stored as reportingParty in beginDispute.
msg.sender provides balance-based voteWeight and voted flag in vote.
msg.sender pays the fork fee and becomes reportedMiner in proposeFork.
msg.sender keys the stakerDetails slot modified by requestStakingWithdraw.
msg.sender keys the stakerDetails slot modified by withdrawStake.
msg.sender is the staker deposited in depositStake.
now gates the dispute and computes minExecutionDate in beginDispute.
now is compared against minExecutionDate and stored as tallyDate in tallyVotes.
now determines the one day unlock window and startDate in unlockDisputeFee.
now sets timeOfLastNewValue in init.
now is aligned to a day boundary as startDate in requestStakingWithdraw.
the 7 day waiting period is measured with now in withdrawStake.
now sets the stake startDate in newStake.
_to is the recipient in transfer.
_amount is the value moved in transfer.
_from is the source account in transferFrom.
_to is the recipient in transferFrom.
_amount is subtracted from allowance and transferred in transferFrom.
_spender receives the allowance in approve.
_user balance is read in balanceOf.
_user checkpoint array is searched in balanceOfAt.
_blockNumber is the lookup block in balanceOfAt.
_value is written into the checkpoint in updateBalanceAtNow.
_disputeId selects the dispute voted on in vote.
_disputeId selects the dispute tallied in tallyVotes.
_disputeId selects the fork dispute in updateTellor.
_disputeId selects the dispute fee unlock target in unlockDisputeFee.
_requestId selects the request being disputed in beginDispute.
_timestamp selects the mined value being disputed in beginDispute.
_minerIndex selects the disputed miner slot in beginDispute.
_propNewTellorAddress is hashed and stored as proposedForkAddress in proposeFork.
_supportsDispute determines the sign of the tally update in vote.
voteWeight derived from historical balance is added or subtracted from tally in vote.
dispRounds scales the dispute fee and minExecutionDate in beginDispute.
_fee is transferred from the reporter in beginDispute.
origID links the chained dispute record in beginDispute.
lastID determines which dispute record is refunded in unlockDisputeFee.
doTransfer writes updated balances through updateBalanceAtNow.
transfer moves balances from msg.sender to _to.
transferFrom moves balances via doTransfer.
transferFrom decrements self.allowed allowance.
approve writes self.allowed allowance.
balanceOfAt reads the checkpointed balances mapping.
updateBalanceAtNow mutates the balances checkpoint array.
beginDispute writes the new Dispute struct.
beginDispute updates disputeIdByDisputeHash for the dispute hash.
beginDispute reads request values and sets inDispute/finalValues.
beginDispute increments the disputeCount uintVar.
vote writes voted flags, numberOfVotes and tally into the dispute.
tallyVotes writes executed, disputeVotePassed and tallyDate.
proposeFork creates the fork Dispute record.
proposeFork increments disputeCount uintVar.
proposeFork maps the fork hash to a dispute id.
updateTellor overwrites addressVars[tellorContract].
updateTellor reads the chain of dispute records.
unlockDisputeFee rewrites dispute paid flag and reads fees.
unlockDisputeFee changes reported miner staking status.
unlockDisputeFee decrements stakerCount and recomputes disputeFee.
unlockDisputeFee restores finalValues and clears inDispute flags.
updateMinDisputeFee recomputes the disputeFee uintVar.
init sets the initial miner balances and contract balance.
init stakes the initial miners through newStake.
init sets decimals, targetMiners, stakeAmount, disputeFee, total_supply.
requestStakingWithdraw changes currentStatus and startDate.
requestStakingWithdraw decrements stakerCount.
withdrawStake resets currentStatus to unlocked.
depositStake writes stakerDetails via newStake.
depositStake increments stakerCount then updates disputeFee.
newStake overwrites the stakerDetails struct.
newStake increments the stakerCount uintVar.
transfer delegates to doTransfer.
transferFrom delegates to doTransfer after allowance check.
balanceOf calls balanceOfAt at block.number.
allowedToTrade queries balanceOf before allowing a trade.
doTransfer calls updateBalanceAtNow for both parties.
doTransfer reads current balances with balanceOf.
beginDispute calls TellorTransfer.doTransfer to collect the dispute fee.
proposeFork calls TellorTransfer.doTransfer to collect the fork fee.
unlockDisputeFee loops over rounds calling doTransfer to pay out fees and stake.
unlockDisputeFee calls updateMinDisputeFee after slashing.
requestStakingWithdraw calls updateMinDisputeFee after decrementing stakerCount.
depositStake calls newStake for msg.sender.
depositStake calls updateMinDisputeFee after staking.
init loops calling newStake for the initial miners.
init calls updateBalanceAtNow to fund the initial miners.
vote calls balanceOfAt to obtain the vote weight.
transfer reaches the balance-mutating transfer path before returning.
transferFrom mutates state and then executes the transfer path.
beginDispute charges the fee via doTransfer after writing dispute state.
proposeFork transfers the flat fork fee at the very start of the function.
unlockDisputeFee performs multiple doTransfer calls inside a loop.
transferFrom performs an unchecked subtraction on the allowance mapping.
requestStakingWithdraw performs an unchecked subtraction of stakerCount.
unlockDisputeFee performs an unchecked subtraction of stakerCount on slashing.
An attacker-controlled token callback during the transfer path can re-enter transfer before balances settle.
Re-entering transferFrom could reuse allowance state mid-update.
Re-entering beginDispute during fee transfer could duplicate dispute state.
Re-entering unlockDisputeFee during payout could double-spend the dispute fee.

normalization_plan.reason: _to only exists as the recipient argument of transfer.
_amount only exists as the value argument of transfer.
_from only exists as the source argument of transferFrom.
_spender only exists as the allowance target of approve.
_user only exists as the balance lookup key of balanceOfAt.
_blockNumber only exists as the historical lookup block of balanceOfAt.
_value only exists as the checkpoint value written by updateBalanceAtNow.
_disputeId primarily selects the dispute being voted on in vote.
_requestId only exists as the disputed oracle request in beginDispute.
_timestamp only exists as the disputed mined timestamp in beginDispute.
_minerIndex only exists as the disputed miner slot in beginDispute.
_propNewTellorAddress only exists as the fork target of proposeFork.
_supportsDispute only exists as the vote direction of vote.
voteWeight is a temporary derived from balanceOfAt used only inside vote.
dispRounds is a temporary round counter used only inside beginDispute.
_fee is a temporary fee value charged by beginDispute.
origID is a temporary dispute chain linkage used only inside beginDispute.
lastID is a temporary dispute chain pointer used only inside unlockDisputeFee.
